proof: After deleting coordinates constant on the class, every relevant Yang-complex section lies in the boundary of the cross-polytope on $\mathrm E(\mathcal H)$ coordinates. Its homology has dimension at most $\mathrm E(\mathcal H)-1$ over every field, giving $\mathrm Y_p(\mathcal H)\leq\mathrm E(\mathcal H)$.
name: Effective Range / Characteristic-p Yang Dimension
